scope: Process-local frozen DINO payload verification only; no learned recurrent state caching
implementation_status: CPU tested, not yet used in a formal cache stage
limits: Current inode/stat match and frozen source path establish a code-derived logical read estimate; historical feature bytes were not rehashed during this audit.
OS page cache can satisfy some reads, so logical duplicate bytes are not measured disk traffic.
Existing per-frame progress seconds stop at the last new frame before final saves and B verification; they cannot serve as completed cache wall time.
No old dedicated SHA timing exists; no speedup ratio or percent wall-time savings is claimed.
Extra validation of an already-existing destination can cause more hashes on a resume; this fresh-run estimate does not invent such calls.
